description: Log a weigh-in in pounds. The newest reading also becomes the user's current weight (drives their calorie targets).

logged_at.description: Bare-local timestamp YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss (no zone). Omit to use the user's 'now'.

tz_offset_min.description: The user's JS getTimezoneOffset() — minutes BEHIND UTC (e.g. 240 for EDT). Optional: when omitted, the user's app-reported timezone is used (UTC only if the account has never reported one).

name: log_weight
